name: 葡萄牙受雇工作居留许可
summary: 面向已持有效受雇工作居留签证，并能证明在葡萄牙存在劳动关系的人士。
summaryEn: For people holding a valid residence visa for employed work who can evidence an employment relationship in Portugal.

visa.summary: 须持有用于受雇工作的有效葡萄牙居留签证。
visa.summaryEn: A valid Portuguese residence visa for employed work is required.

jobOffer.summary: 须由雇主声明现有劳动关系，并提交官方要求的相关证明。
jobOffer.summaryEn: The employer must attest to the employment relationship and the required evidence must be supplied.

general.summary: 还须满足护照、住址、税务、社保及公共秩序等适用的一般条件。
general.summaryEn: Applicable general conditions concerning passport, address, tax, social security and public order must also be met.

sources.authority: Portugal Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA)
sources.title: Residence permit for employed professional activity with residence visa — Article 88(1)

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
